lines.trans: Alright, go ahead, what do you want to name him?
Nothing of the sort, dear Nastya.
Dmitry is a very handsome name.
Well look closely for yourself.
Here is Dmitry, and here is some Kuzma.
You know, the name Dmitry at least sounds good.
And what is wrong with the name Kuzma for you?
Honestly, I do not even know that.
Let us ask Max right now.
Max, tell us, Dmitry is better, right?
Take your order, please.
